title: Niagara & GPU Particle Simulation Overhead
fix_rationale: The GPU is spending excessive frame time in FXSystem / Niagara simulation and particle rendering. Tuning GPU particle budgets, distance culling, and emitter instance limits will restore GPU performance.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms ({share}% of excess time) during GPU particle simulation.

fixes.text: Set fx.Niagara.GPUComputeBudget to limit maximum particle compute dispatch duration.
Set fx.MaxNiagaraGPUParticles to clamp total active GPU particles in the scene.
Enable particle system distance culling and reduce emitter spawn rates on distant systems.
Audit particle overdraw in Shader Complexity view mode and reduce overlapping translucent particle quads.

verify: Adjust fx.Niagara.GPUComputeBudget or fx.MaxNiagaraGPUParticles and verify that FXSystemPreRender / Niagara GPU pass times decrease proportionally.
